title: Forbidden Land
next_chapter_hook: Just as the golden figure stepped into the ruins, the entire space seemed to be locked by some supreme will, and that cold voice rang like thunder across all directions—"This thing does not belong to you."

text.content: "Your chess game is being watched." The elderly voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder, and his blood-wiping fingertips suddenly froze. Watched? Who is watching? The old monsters from the three great sects, or... something even more terrifying? He slowly raised his head, his gaze piercing through layers of mist to fall upon that faintly visible golden light deep within the ruins. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms grew slightly warm, as if responding to something. A cold smirk curled at the corner of his mouth, his voice low as an abyss: "Being watched, you say... then let them watch their fill." With that, he stepped on the bloodstains, walking step by step toward the deepest part of the ruins, each step steady and resolute.

The deeper the ruins' passage went, the more bizarre it became. The walls were covered with obscure glyphs that glowed with a faint blue light. Chen Ji could feel an invisible pressure pressing in from all directions—that was the weight of time, the grudges left by countless failures. His spiritual sense carefully probed outward, only to be ruthlessly bounced back upon touching some barrier. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled, and Mo Xiansheng's fragmented voice echoed hauntingly: "Boy, what's sealed here... is a taboo I didn't dare touch back then. Are you sure you want to continue?" Chen Ji gave no answer, only retrieving from his chest the broken jade piece Chen Nian had left him—the only thing his sister had left before disappearing. Strangely, the closer he approached the ruins' depths, the warmer the broken jade became, as if guiding him toward something.

Passing through the final stone door, the scene before Chen Ji's eyes made his pupils contract sharply. A massive altar stood in the center of the cavern, nine black-gold chains hung down from the domed ceiling, suspending a crystal-clear jade slip in mid-air. The aura emanating from that jade slip was identical to the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms—no, more precisely, the fragment's aura originated from this jade slip. A memory from Mo Xiansheng flashed through Chen Ji's mind: "The Tianji Record has nine pages, scattered across the world..." Could this be the legendary complete version of the Tianji Record? Just then, the suspended jade slip suddenly erupted with blinding light, and the fragment in Chen Ji's arms flew out uncontrollably, facing the jade slip from afar.

"Impossible..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly as he stared死死 at the jade slip, his inner shock beyond description. This was the complete Tianji Record he had been searching for all along? With it, he could foresee a more distant future, and perhaps even find his sister Chen Nian. However, just as the fragment drew near the jade slip, a piercing female scream suddenly rang out—it was Chen Nian's voice! Chen Ji shuddered all over, hastily looking at the broken jade in his hand, only to see the jade pendant flashing frantically with blood-red light, as if transmitting some dangerous signal. A blurry image suddenly flooded his mind: imperial dragon robes, golden eyes, and a young girl bound by chains in the darkness.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly burst out from the fragment. That originally ethereal figure had now solidified considerably, his face full of horror: "This aura... it's the Eye of Heavenly Dao! Boy, you've lost your mind! This is no ordinary Tianji Record—this is a trap it set!" Chen Ji's expression turned gloomy, but he didn't retreat. He stared at the jade slip, his voice ice-cold: "Tell me, what does this have to do with Chen Nian?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then finally spoke: "Chen Nian's bloodline... is the only existence that can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. The Eye of Heavenly Dao chose her back then, specifically to..." Before he could finish, the entire altar suddenly began to shake violently, and those nine black-gold chains slowly started to unravel.

dialogue.content: "For what?!" Chen Ji's voice rose sharply as he grabbed Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, his eyes filled with anxiety and killing intent. Mo Xiansheng sighed, his voice carrying a hint of helplessness: "To ensure that every generation of seers remains under its control forever. The Eye of Heavenly Dao will never allow any existence to leave its chessboard... Chen Nian is its final weapon against Tianji Record holders. Her bloodline can interfere with foresight, and can equally become chains." Chen Ji's fingernails dug deep into his palms, blood dripping, yet he seemed to feel no pain. "So the Holy Sect taking her away..." his voice low as an abyss, "was the Eye of Heavenly Dao's scheme from the very beginning?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng gave no answer, but that silence itself was the answer. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the surging fury and killing intent in his heart, his gaze returning to that suspended jade slip. He suddenly noticed that on the jade slip was inscribed a line of tiny text—"With blood as the guide, with life as the medium, the complete one may peer into Heavenly Fate, but must also endure Heavenly Fate's backlash." He sneered: "So this is the price?" Mo Xiansheng said gravely: "Boy, this thing cannot be touched. Once you fuse with it, the Eye of Heavenly Dao can directly control you through it..." Chen Ji interrupted him: "Then what if I don't fuse, but take it away?"

Mo Xiansheng froze for a moment, then bitterly smiled: "You think the Eye of Heavenly Dao will give you that choice?" No sooner had he spoken than the jade slip erupted with a terrifying aura, and a majestic and cold voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: "The inheritor of the Tianji Record... I have been waiting for you for a long time." I? Chen Ji's pupils contracted—this self-reference made him think of a terrifying possibility—Imperial Court! That transcendent existence above the three great sects! At the same time, countless obscure auras were rapidly approaching from the darkness around the altar. Chen Ji could sense that at least three of those auras had reached the level of sect elders.

choice.prompt: The Imperial Court forces have intervened, the complete Tianji Record is right before his eyes yet crisis lurks on all sides. Faced with this opportunity that could change everything, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Risk everything to seize the jade slip
choices.description: This is a rare once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The complete Tianji Record would let him foresee a more distant future and find his sister. Though the Imperial Court is powerful, he never fights without preparation.
choices.visible_cost: May face direct pursuit from Imperial Court forces
choices.visible_reward: The power of the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze grows increasingly clear—any slight misstep will lead to utter destruction

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp as he vigorously stimulated the spiritual energy within his body, the distance between the fragment and that jade slip shrinking dramatically. At the same time, the broken jade in his hand burst forth with a warm light, within which a blurry feminine figure appeared faintly. "Nian'er..." His voice was low and firm, "Wait for your brother." With that, his entire person transformed into a stream of light, charging toward the jade slip.

choices.description: As long as the green mountains remain, there will be firewood to burn. The Imperial Court's involvement proves the secrets here are more terrifying than he imagined. He needs more intelligence, more preparation, to walk more steadily in this grand game of chess.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve combat strength, gain intelligence advantage
choices.risk_hint: The jade slip's aura is dissipating—the next opportunity may come at an unknown time

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly withdrew his spiritual energy, his form rapidly retreating. He glanced at the suspended jade slip, then at the blood-gleaming broken jade in his hand, his eyes flickering with reluctance and resolve. "Imperial Court..." he murmured this unfamiliar and terrifying name, a meaningful cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth, "It seems I underestimated this chess game." With that, he transformed into a dark shadow, silently fleeing outward.

However, just as he fled into the darkness, a golden figure suddenly appeared at the altar's entrance. That person wore robes embroidered with five-clawed golden dragons, a purple-gold crown atop his head, and radiated a pressure that even Chen Ji found suffocating. He had never witnessed such momentum—even the old monsters of the three great sects would pale before this individual. "Interesting..." the golden-robed figure slowly spoke, his voice not loud yet clearly echoing throughout the entire ruins, "The Tianji Record Fragment holder is indeed as cautious as the rumors suggest." Chen Ji froze all over, an unprecedented crisis washing over him. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled frantically, as if warning him of something.

The golden-robed figure slowly walked toward the altar, his gaze sweeping over the suspended jade slip, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips. His gaze seemed capable of penetrating all barriers, directly locking onto Chen Ji's hiding spot. "No need to hide, inheritor of the Tianji Record." His voice remained calm yet carried an undeniable majesty, "Since I could find this place, you have no second chance." I! Chen Ji's heart was thrown into turmoil—this self-reference thoroughly confirmed his guess—the person before him was the Lord of the Imperial Court! That legendary existence above all sects, before which even Heavenly Dao must step back!

dialogue.content: The golden-robed figure raised his hand, and an invisible force suddenly enveloped the entire altar, the shadows where Chen Ji hid being forcibly expelled. He steadied his stance, his gaze死死 locked on this terrifying opponent, his voice hoarse: "Imperial Court... why intervene in this matter?" The golden-robed figure smiled lightly, that smile carrying a hint of amusement: "Why? Because this thing never belonged to you mortals." He turned toward the suspended jade slip, his eyes flickering with a complex light, "The complete Tianji Record... I have waited for it for exactly three hundred years."

text.content: Three hundred years of waiting? Chen Ji keenly caught this crucial information, his heart thrown into even greater turmoil. The Lord of the Imperial Court had lived for three hundred years? There must be something amiss here. However, before he could think further, the golden-robed figure had already raised his hand, a golden light enveloping the suspended jade slip. Just then, the broken jade in Chen Ji's hand suddenly burst forth with blinding light, a blurry feminine figure emerging from within. "Brother..." that voice was weak yet urgent, "Don't let him get it... once the Tianji Record is complete... the Eye of Heavenly Dao will..."

Before she could finish, a cold glint flashed in the golden-robed figure's eyes, and with a casual wave, a golden sword qi slashed toward the broken jade in Chen Ji's hand. "Clamorous." His voice was cold as frost, "A container dares act so impertinently here." Chen Ji's pupils contracted, his form暴退 retreating rapidly, while the fragment frantically activated, a time barrier barely forming before the broken jade. The sword qi collided with the barrier, producing a deafening roar, and the entire ruins shook violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed: "This is... the Imperial Court's nation-protecting divine technique! Boy, you can't block this!"

choice.prompt: The Imperial Court Lord's strength far exceeds imagination, Chen Nian's warning was interrupted, and crucial information remains unspoken. Facing this desperate situation, Chen Ji must make a choice—

text.content: Chen Ji bit through his tongue, spraying refined blood onto the fragment. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with unprecedented light, within which a cold vertical pupil faintly manifested. The golden-robed figure's expression finally changed: "This is... the power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao? No, how could you—" Chen Ji's voice was cold as an abyss: "Don't you want the complete Tianji Record? Then let me show you just a fraction of it!"

text.content: A flash of resolve crossed Chen Ji's eyes as he hurled the broken jade in his hand toward the jade slip. The golden-robed figure's pupils contracted, instinctively reaching out to catch it—that was a key item related to the Eye of Heavenly Dao's schemes! In that flash of lightning, Chen Ji's form shot backward, his entire person transforming into a dark shadow rushing toward the rear passage. "Chen Nian, wait for your brother!" His voice echoed in the darkness, "Imperial Court... this humiliation, I Chen Ji记住了!"

However, just as Chen Ji was about to flee into the passage, an even more majestic voice rang from the depths of the ruins: "Imperial Court Majesty, why trouble yourself with a junior?" That voice was aged yet profound, as if arriving from ancient times, causing the golden-robed figure's expression to slightly change. At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms suddenly grew scalding hot, and Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice sounded: "It's him! It's him! Tianqing Sect's old Patriarch—Ling Yuan! He's actually still alive!" Ling Yuan! That old monster who had been hiding in the shadows—appearing at this critical moment!

An aged figure slowly emerged from the depths of the altar—that was precisely Tianqing Sect's old Patriarch Ling Yuan. His gaze swept over Chen Ji, then fell upon the golden-robed figure, finally fixing on the suspended jade slip, his turbid eyes flickering with a complex mix of greed and wariness. "Imperial Court Majesty," Ling Yuan clasped his hands in greeting, his tone neither humble nor overbearing, "This ruin was left by my Tianqing Sect's ancestors—shouldn't the things within... not be touched by outsiders?" The golden-robed figure coldly laughed: "Tianqing Sect? Merely a small sect, dares to be impertinent before me?" Ling Yuan showed no anger, instead smiling: "Your Majesty, please don't rush—the things sealed within these ruins concern far more than just the Tianji Record..."

Chen Ji silently retreated to the passage's edge while the two confronted each other. His mind rapidly organized the information he had just acquired: the complete Tianji Record, Chen Nian's bloodline interference ability, the Imperial Court's involvement, Ling Yuan's appearance... this chess game was far more complex than he had imagined. Just then, the fragment in his hand suddenly transmitted a warm sensation, a blurry image flashing through his mind—it was a scene of Chen Nian. She was bound by countless golden chains in a mysterious space, surrounded by countless cold vertical pupils... "Brother..." her voice was weak yet firm, "I'm okay... but be careful... it... it's right beside you..."

dialogue.content: Just then, another disturbance came from the ruins' entrance. The golden-robed figure's brow slightly furrowed as he turned to look—only to see a golden figure stepping through the void, radiating an aura that made everyone present feel suffocating. Before that person had even landed, a cold voice already echoed throughout the ruins: "This thing does not belong to you." Chen Ji shuddered all over, raising his head to look—only to see a middle-aged man in golden robes and imperial crown, dragon qi swirling around his body, his momentum so terrifying it exceeded Ling Yuan and the golden-robed figure combined by threefold. Who... was this? Was there someone in the Imperial Court more powerful than the Majesty himself?

text.content: However, what truly filled Chen Ji with dread was the unprecedented tremor transmitted from the Tianji Record Fragment after that person's arrival. That was not the aura of Imperial Court dragon qi, but something far more ancient, far colder, far more lofty—an existence—the aura of the Eye of Heavenly Dao! Chen Ji froze rigidly, a chilling thought flooding his mind: Could it be... behind the Imperial Court Lord lies an even more terrifying existence?
